window_analysis.comment: provider: VLM提供商; history_window_count: 上下文窗口数; max_output_chars: 输出字数限制; min_frames_ratio: R1帧完成比例要求(0.3=30%，适应实时流处理延迟)

chat_assistant.comment: provider: 聊天使用的VLM(gemini/qwen/glm); compress_window_count: 每N个窗口总结进行一次压缩; max_context_summaries: 最大压缩总结数量

surgr1.comment: SurgR1 API - 手术图片分析（bbox定位、动作描述、阶段识别）[核心服务，必须开启]，支持动态batch_size

glm.comment: VLM用于多图像分析总结，当前使用Qwen3-VL-8B（可切换GLM-4.6V-Flash）

sam3.comment: SAM3 API - 给定SurgR1模型的bbox输出做mask分割 [可选服务]

tts.speaker: 中文女
tts.comment: CosyVoice TTS API - 给定中文文本输入，输出中文女声 [可选服务]

asr.comment: FunASR API - 长时间监控模式，唤醒后待机N分钟后进入监控模式 [可选服务]

gemini.comment: Gemini 3.0 Flash API - Google多模态分析，需设置GEMINI_API_KEY环境变量 [可选服务]

video_processing.comment: N=15秒窗口，每秒采样1帧，每个窗口15帧

questions.tool_localization: Given the laparoscopic surgical image <image>, locate all the tools in the format of bbox (x1,y1), (x2,y2).
questions.surgical_action: Given the laparoscopic surgical image <image>, describe the complete surgical action in terms of tool, action, and tissue.
questions.surgical_phase: Given the laparoscopic surgical image <image>, which surgical phase does this frame belong to? Choose from: Preparation, CalotTriangleDissection, ClippingCutting, GallbladderDissection, GallbladderPackaging, CleaningCoagulation, GallbladderRetraction.

mysql.comment: MySQL用于存储所有数据（会话、分析结果、对话历史）

openai.comment: 用于GPT总结和TTS（备用），从 .env 读取 OPENAI_API_KEY
